rubrics.justification: The response overstates visible morphology from a single static image, describing a clearly delineated blastocoel, thinning zona, and detailed ICM/TE features that are not convincingly appreciable here; the image appears lower quality/collapsed and does not robustly support a confident 3AA-style visual read.
It integrates age, DOR, AMH/FSH, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, and endometrium well, linking them to prognosis and transfer expectations.

The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors, though some adjustments are somewhat subjective and morphology-based confidence is overstated.

Much of the discussion is broadly evidence-based, but recommendations such as routine GH, ERA after limited failure history, NK-cell testing/intralipids, thrombophilia workup, and empiric aspirin/heparin are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring, luteal support considerations, and future-cycle planning, though some suggested add-ons are more speculative than standard-of-care.
